bRealTimeCapture.description:
When enabled, the sky will be captured and convolved to achieve dynamic diffuse and specular environment lighting.
SkyAtmosphere, VolumetricCloud Components as well as sky domes with Sky materials are taken into account.

sourceType.title: ESkyLightSourceType
sourceType.description: Indicates where to get the light contribution from.

cubemap.title: /Script/Engine.TextureCube
cubemap.description: Cubemap to use for sky lighting if SourceType is set to SLS_SpecifiedCubemap.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

sourceCubemapAngle.description: Angle to rotate the source cubemap when SourceType is set to SLS_SpecifiedCubemap.

cubemapResolution.description: Maximum resolution for the very top processed cubemap mip. Must be a power of 2.

skyDistanceThreshold.description:
Distance from the sky light at which any geometry should be treated as part of the sky.
This is also used by reflection captures, so update reflection captures to see the impact.

bCaptureEmissiveOnly.description: Only capture emissive materials. Skips all lighting making the capture cheaper. Recomended when using CaptureEveryFrame

bLowerHemisphereIsBlack.description:
Whether all distant lighting from the lower hemisphere should be set to LowerHemisphereColor.
Enabling this is accurate when lighting a scene on a planet where the ground blocks the sky,
However disabling it can be useful to approximate skylight bounce lighting (eg Movable light).

occlusionMaxDistance.description:
Max distance that the occlusion of one point will affect another.
Higher values increase the cost of Distance Field AO exponentially.

contrast.description: Contrast S-curve applied to the computed AO.  A value of 0 means no contrast increase, 1 is a significant contrast increase.

occlusionExponent.description: Exponent applied to the computed AO.  Values lower than 1 brighten occlusion overall without losing contact shadows.

minOcclusion.description: Controls the darkest that a fully occluded area can get.  This tends to destroy contact shadows, use Contrast or OcclusionExponent instead.

occlusionTint.title: LinearColor
occlusionTint.description: Tint color on occluded areas, artistic control.

bCloudAmbientOcclusion.description: Whether the cloud should occlude sky contribution within the atmosphere (progressively fading multiple scattering out) or not.

cloudAmbientOcclusionStrength.description: The strength of the ambient occlusion, higher value will block more light.

cloudAmbientOcclusionExtent.description: The world space radius of the cloud ambient occlusion map around the camera in kilometers.

cloudAmbientOcclusionMapResolutionScale.description: Scale the cloud ambient occlusion map resolution, base resolution is 512. The resolution is still clamped to 'r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.MaxResolution'.

cloudAmbientOcclusionApertureScale.description: Controls the cone aperture angle over which the sky occlusion due to volumetric clouds is evaluated. A value of 1 means `take into account the entire hemisphere` resulting in blurry occlusion, while a value of 0 means `take into account a single up occlusion direction up` resulting in sharp occlusion.

occlusionCombineMode.title: EOcclusionCombineMode
occlusionCombineMode.description: Controls how occlusion from Distance Field Ambient Occlusion is combined with Screen Space Ambient Occlusion.

intensity.description: Total energy that the light emits.

lightColor.title: LinearColor
lightColor.description:
Filter color of the light.
Note that this can change the light's effective intensity.

bAffectsWorld.description:
Whether the light can affect the world, or whether it is disabled.
A disabled light will not contribute to the scene in any way.  This setting cannot be changed at runtime and unbuilds lighting when changed.
Setting this to false has the same effect as deleting the light, so it is useful for non-destructive experiments.

castShadows.description: Whether the light should cast any shadows.

castStaticShadows.description: Whether the light should cast shadows from static objects.  Also requires Cast Shadows to be set to True.

castDynamicShadows.description: Whether the light should cast shadows from dynamic objects.  Also requires Cast Shadows to be set to True.

bAffectTranslucentLighting.description: Whether the light affects translucency or not.  Disabling this can save GPU time when there are many small lights.

bTransmission.description: Whether light from this light transmits through surfaces with subsurface scattering profiles. Requires light to be movable.

bCastVolumetricShadow.description: Whether the light shadows volumetric fog.  Disabling this can save GPU time.

bCastDeepShadow.description: Whether the light should cast high quality hair-strands self-shadowing. When this option is enabled, an extra GPU cost for this light.

bAffectReflection.description: Whether the light affects objects in reflections, when ray-traced reflection is enabled.

bAffectGlobalIllumination.description: Whether the light affects global illumination, when ray-traced global illumination is enabled.

deepShadowLayerDistribution.description: Change the deep shadow layers distribution 0:linear distribution (uniform layer distribution), 1:exponential (more details on near small details).

indirectLightingIntensity.description:
Scales the indirect lighting contribution from this light.
A value of 0 disables any GI from this light. Default is 1.

volumetricScatteringIntensity.description: Intensity of the volumetric scattering from this light.  This scales Intensity and LightColor.

samplesPerPixel.description: Samples per pixel for ray tracing

relativeLocation.title: Vector
relativeLocation.description: Location of the component relative to its parent

relativeRotation.title: Rotator
relativeRotation.description: Rotation of the component relative to its parent

relativeScale3D.title: Vector
relativeScale3D.description:
Non-uniform scaling of the component relative to its parent.
Note that scaling is always applied in local space (no shearing etc)

bAbsoluteLocation.description: If RelativeLocation should be considered relative to the world, rather than the parent

bAbsoluteRotation.description: If RelativeRotation should be considered relative to the world, rather than the parent

bAbsoluteScale.description: If RelativeScale3D should be considered relative to the world, rather than the parent

bVisible.description: Whether to completely draw the primitive; if false, the primitive is not drawn, does not cast a shadow.

bShouldUpdatePhysicsVolume.description:
Whether or not the cached PhysicsVolume this component overlaps should be updated when the component is moved.
@see GetPhysicsVolume()

bHiddenInGame.description: Whether to hide the primitive in game, if the primitive is Visible.

bUseAttachParentBound.description:
If true, this component uses its parents bounds when attached.
This can be a significant optimization with many components attached together.

mobility.title: EComponentMobility
mobility.description: How often this component is allowed to move, used to make various optimizations. Only safe to set in constructor.

detailMode.title: EDetailMode
detailMode.description:
Set the required detail level of this component.
It will be deleted or made invisible if the world's detail level is higher, based on platform and scalability settings.
For example, a detail mode of High may prevent this component from loading on mobile platforms.

primaryComponentTick.title: ActorComponentTickFunction
primaryComponentTick.description: Main tick function for the Component

tickGroup.title: ETickingGroup
tickGroup.description:
Defines the first tick group where this function can be executed.
These groups determine the relative order of when objects tick during a frame update.
If this function has prerequisites, execution may be delayed to a later group.

endTickGroup.title: ETickingGroup
endTickGroup.description:
Defines the tick group that this tick function must finish within.
Normal synchronous ticks do not need to set this manually.
The game thread will stall at the end of this group if the function (or a spawned task) is still in progress.

bTickEvenWhenPaused.description: Bool indicating that this function should execute even if the gameplay is paused. Pause ticks are very limited in capabilities.

bStartWithTickEnabled.description: If true, this tick function will start enabled, but can be disabled later on.

bAllowTickOnDedicatedServer.description: If we allow this tick to run on a dedicated server

tickInterval.description: The time in seconds between executions of this tick function. If <= 0 then it will tick every frame.

componentTags.description: Array of tags that can be used for grouping and categorizing. Can also be accessed from scripting.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

assetUserData.description: Array of user data stored with the component

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

assetUserDataEditorOnly.description: Array of user data stored with the component

bReplicateUsingRegisteredSubObjectList.description:
When true the replication system will only replicate the registered subobjects list
When false the replication system will instead call the virtual ReplicateSubObjects() function where the subobjects need to be manually replicated.

bReplicates.description: Is this component currently replicating? Should the network code consider it for replication? Owning Actor must be replicating first!

bAutoActivate.description: Whether the component is activated at creation or must be explicitly activated.

bEditableWhenInherited.description: True if this component can be modified when it was inherited from a parent actor class

bCanEverAffectNavigation.description: Whether this component can potentially influence navigation

bIsEditorOnly.description: If true, the component will be excluded from non-editor builds
